_doc: Frozen GNU Make VPATH evidence configuration for REL_16_11 (plan step 1). Every make_evidence.py subcommand reads this file; nothing here may change inside one evidence cycle. Reasons for every disabled optional feature and for the builddir location are in evidence/environment.md.
external_roots_note: builddir, prefix and evidence_out live under /Users/niejinbo/pg-builds on the single APFS data volume; srcdir is the read-only base worktree on the same volume. There is no virtiofs/network mount in this baseline.

migration.from: openEuler 22.03 (OrbStack Linux VM): srcdir on the virtiofs /Users mount, builddir/prefix/evidence_out on the VM-native btrfs root /home/redstar/pg-builds
migration.to: native macOS (Darwin/arm64): all four roots on the APFS data volume, builddir/prefix/evidence_out under /Users/niejinbo/pg-builds
migration.reason: The Linux evidence host is no longer available. The baseline was re-established natively on the macOS host. The virtiofs POSIX caveats that forced the old builddir off /Users (readdir() EACCES on a mode-0400 directory; cross-process reads seeing zeros) do not exist here: srcdir, builddir and the test tmpdir are on one local APFS filesystem.

disabled_features.--enable-dtrace: no usable DTrace/sdt probe support for this frozen build on macOS
disabled_features.--with-ldap: LDAP is not part of the frozen minimal build
disabled_features.--with-pam: PAM is not part of the frozen minimal build
disabled_features.--with-uuid=e2fs: left at the configure default; the e2fs-style uuid_generate is otherwise available via libSystem
disabled_features.--with-lz4: lz4 headers/libs are not in the SDK and no brew package was installed
disabled_features.--with-zstd: zstd headers/libs are not in the SDK and no brew package was installed
disabled_features.--with-icu: the SDK exposes libicucore but no unicode/ucol.h and no icu pkg-config file
disabled_features.--with-python: the CommandLineTools Python 3.9 framework lacks a linkable libpython for embedding
disabled_features.--enable-tap-tests: IPC::Run is not installed for the system perl 5.34, so the TAP suite cannot run
disabled_features.--with-llvm: not part of the frozen minimal build
disabled_features.--with-bonjour: not part of the frozen minimal build

env_unset_note: The build and test environment is created with env -i from the env block above; LC_ALL, LANGUAGE, TZ, TMPDIR, PGPORT, PGHOST, PGDATA, PG_TEST_EXTRA, PROVE_FLAGS, MAKEFLAGS and PKG_CONFIG_PATH are intentionally absent. LDFLAGS/CPPFLAGS point at the keg-only brew gettext (libintl, --enable-nls), openssl@3 (OpenSSL 3.5 headers and libs, --with-openssl) and krb5 (gssapi/gssapi.h and libgssapi_krb5, --with-gssapi); they are unrelated to the translation tree. PATH puts keg-only openssl@3 first so that `openssl` resolves to the same 3.5 tree the compiler links (Homebrew also links an openssl@4 that only krb5 depends on).

capture_targets.name: check_prereqs
capture_targets.note: compile the test programs/modules that check-world would otherwise build in parallel (src/test/regress, isolation, modules); needed for .o/.Po/argv closure

capture_targets.name: check_prereqs_ecpg
capture_targets.note: ecpg test programs (generated TUs in builddir)

capture_targets.name: check_prereqs_pg_bsd_indent
capture_targets.note: pg_bsd_indent is built only by its own TAP check (not by world-bin); its 7 objects would otherwise be compiled in parallel by check-world

capture_targets.name: install
capture_targets.note: install into the frozen prefix before check-world. macOS /bin/sh strips DYLD_* from the environment of the commands it runs, so the DESTDIR=tmp_install staging that `make check` performs cannot resolve the staged binaries' absolute install-name libraries over DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH: initdb aborts with 'Library not loaded: <prefix>/lib/libpq.5.dylib'. Populating the real prefix makes that path exist. This compiles nothing (world-bin already built everything); it is captured for completeness and so check-world is reproducible from a clean builddir+prefix.

check_world._doc: -j1 is mandatory on this host: macOS ships GNU Make 3.81, which has no --output-sync/-O (added in 3.82), and checkworld.py needs every recursive make's output kept together - at -j8 without output sync the '# +++ ... check in DIR +++' anchors and the Entering/Leaving directory cwd stack would be interleaved across sibling submakes. Sequential output is grouped by construction. -k so every suite runs even after a failure (the failure set must be complete, not whatever make happened to start before the first error).
